independentPenaltyComparator.source: Wave 7.193 cutoff-one optimized-order dense-MPO parity-penalty run

established: The exact local and virtual Z2 compiler is executable as a block-sparse two-site DMRG. It reproduces three exact reduced-system controls to below 8e-12 and reproduces the independent full 24-channel cutoff-one penalty-sector gap to 0.0252 percent without a parity penalty.
boundary: The 24-channel run did not meet the solver tolerance, is only at cutoff one and bond 16, and supplies neither a certified spectral enclosure nor a laboratory realization. It validates the symmetry-native numerical bridge, not cutoff or bond convergence and not the Monster provenance of the rotor by itself.
